lines.en: I walk and cry at the same time.
My skin hangs loose on me.
Every step splashes in the marsh.
I leave wet prints behind.
Tears drop onto the grass.

lines.zh: 我从小水洼边上绕过去。
lines.en: I skirt around the little pool.
No one can catch up with my sorrow.
I sob between steps.
The swamp fog wraps around me.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，像要沉下去。
lines.en: I walk so slowly it looks like sinking.
The ground's soft. Nothing holds.
Hugging myself as I go.
In the fog I only see my feet.
I shuffle step by step to the water.
Sitting, my shoulders keep shaking.
I've cried my own face wet.
Nothing here smells good.
My eyes stay red.
I can't remember why I cry.
Water drips off my hide.
Nobody comes to sit with me.
I look up at the sky, then down again.
I've sat in this hollow a long while.

lines.zh: 我的哭声在雾里散不开。
lines.en: My sobbing won't leave the fog.
So tired, and I can't sleep.
The fog is thickening.
Even the wind feels wet.

lines.zh: 我停了一会儿，又哭起来。
lines.en: I stop for a moment, then cry again.
Did you hear me crying too?
How long have you stood there?

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我的伤心会传。
lines.en: Don't come close. My grief is catching.
You look sad as well.

lines.zh: 我一个人在这里很久了。
lines.en: I've been alone here a long while.
Have you come to drive me off?
I'm always dripping.

lines.zh: 你手上那东西，是曲奇吗？
lines.en: Is that a cookie in your hand?
Why don't you say anything?
There's a weight on my chest.
When I weep, the fog thickens.
Don't pity me. Truly.

lines.zh: 我抱着自己被撞的地方。
lines.en: I clutch where I was struck.
I staggered back a step.
It hurts. Please stop hitting me.
I'm dripping water — and blood.
I curl on the ground.
My crying has changed pitch.
I only wanted to leave.
Don't look at me like this.
Those aren't cookies, are they?
One piece, just one.
I haven't had anything sweet in ages.
You'll regret giving me this.
After I eat it I might feel worse.
Don't take it away. Just set it down.

lines.zh: 我可以拿这个换你一样东西。
lines.en: I can trade you something for it.

lines.zh: 甜味把雾都压下去一点。
lines.en: The sweetness pushes the fog back a little.
Is there anything else in your hand?
I hold it, not daring to bite.

lines.zh: 你手心是暖的，我不敢碰。
lines.en: Your palm is warm; I daren't touch.
I really do thank you.

lines.zh: 我哭得连味道都尝不清。
lines.en: I'm crying too hard to taste it.
I'll save this piece for later.
Would you like a piece too?
I'm wet. Don't mind me.
Don't push. I'll move myself.
I've shrunk off to the side.

lines.zh: 你踩过来，我眼泪就掉了。
lines.en: You step on me and tears fall.

lines.zh: 我们碰在一起，像两团泥。
lines.en: We met like two lumps of mud.
My hide's slick. Nothing holds.
I'm backing off. Don't follow.
Now you're wet from me too.
There's no benefit in touching me.
I'm crying too hard to speak.
Something like me — nobody wants it.
There's only me in this swamp.
Don't bring that up. It makes it worse.
My eyes are swollen shut.
I can't even look after myself.

lines.zh: 这些事不会发生在我身上。
lines.en: That won't happen to me.
Leave me alone, please.

lines.zh: 我会把别人也拖进悲伤里。
lines.en: I'd drag anyone else into sorrow.
I lower my head and don't answer.
Are these my own tears?
I lift it, and my hand lets go.
Cloth to wipe my face.
Soaked through. Useless.

lines.zh: 我的眼泪，会把你也拖下去。
lines.en: My tears will pull you down too.
Picking it up to give back.
That isn't mine.
I hold it and sit a while.
Don't come closer. I'll cry louder.

lines.zh: 哭泣的斯康克，朝你挪半步。
lines.en: The weeping squonk shuffles half a step your way.
I'll hide in the fog.
I don't want to fight. Only to flee.
You snapped a branch.
I edge back toward the water.
There's no path out of here.
I'm running. Running now.
Why are you still looking for me?
Please stop following me.
Please don't keep following me.
My legs have gone weak.
I'm behind a stand of reeds.
My steps are getting heavier.
I'm running slower and slower.
Why haven't you left?

lines.zh: 我的眼泪把地都泡湿了。
lines.en: My tears have soaked the ground.
Don't grab me. It hurts.
I slap your hand away.
I bumped you because I want to run.
I can't see the way for crying.
Sorry. I'm sorry.
That one was really light.
I fell, and got up again.
I'm retreating into the bog.
Out of the mire, first a sob.
It's damp here. I like that.
My eyes are red and swollen.
I'm already crying.
Water drips off me.
The swamp took me in.
I bury my face in my hands.
Did someone just pass by?
I stepped into a puddle.
I'm alone again.
Fire shriveled my hide.

lines.zh: 我从泥坡滚下去，满身是水。
lines.en: I rolled down the muddy slope, soaked.
The bog is pulling me under.
The blast threw me into the reeds.
Arrow in my shoulder, and I cry again.

lines.zh: 那光让我想起很伤心的事。
lines.en: That light brought back something awful.
Too hungry even to cry.
Lightning struck and I slumped in the mud.
Falling, my tears fly upward.
